'''2011 US Nationals Stephen Kim DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kim]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Stephen Ki
* '''Deck name:''' Anti-CoT
* '''Username:''' vaith
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
